data.title: bn-1b3n: Fresh-eyes review of changes since v1.0.0-pre.13
data.description: Fresh-eyes fixes for recovery path containment and native LFS materialization.

data.body: LOW (defense-in-depth): checked_restore_destination() blocks parent *symlink* escape, but write_with_mode() at the final destination removes only a symlink before fs::write. If the final path component is a pre-existing *hardlink* to a file outside the workspace, fs::write follows the inode and overwrites that outside file with snapshot bytes. This is a residual, not a regression — it is gated by the kernel's fs.protected_hardlinks (default on) and requires prior local write access to the workspace. Consider O_NOFOLLOW/open-with-truncate or an st_nlink==1 check for the destination as a hardening follow-up.

LOW (informational): the symlink-parent check in checked_restore_destination() runs before create_dir_all() and write_with_mode(), so a TOCTOU window exists if a parent component is swapped to a symlink between the check and the write. Not exploitable in the single-owner workspace model maw assumes, but worth a note. The lexical + symlink layering here is otherwise correct and a real improvement over the prior default_ws.join(path).

data.reason: Security review: no exploitable issues. Diff hardens recover --restore-file against parent-symlink escape and stops following destination symlinks; LFS smudge is now correctly gated on target-commit attributes (fixes wrong smudge of pointer-shaped non-LFS files). Two LOW defense-in-depth notes filed (final-destination hardlink, check→write TOCTOU) — non-blocking.

data.body: Verified fixed in ecbd8f4b: write_with_mode now remove_file()s the directory entry first (unlinking the name leaves any outside hardlink's inode and content intact), then opens with OpenOptions::create_new(true) (O_CREAT|O_EXCL). O_EXCL refuses to follow a pre-existing symlink or hardlink and fails closed with EEXIST, so snapshot bytes can no longer overwrite a file outside the workspace. The mode==120000 symlink branch is unaffected (remove+symlink). Residual hardlink escape closed.

Informational note, no fix required. The lexical (validate_show_path) + per-parent symlink_metadata check is the correct containment layer, and create_new(O_EXCL) on the final open also fails closed on a concurrently-inserted final-component link. The residual parent-swap TOCTOU is inherent to path-by-name resolution and is not exploitable in maw's single-owner workspace model. Resolving as acknowledged.

data.reason: Security fixes verified: hardlink escape in write_with_mode closed via remove_file + create_new(O_EXCL); recover restore path containment (lexical + parent symlink check) sound; LFS smudge paths fail closed (retain pointer) with no data loss and no shell injection.
